name: librechat
description: Restricted LibreChat assistant connected to a tenant vLLM endpoint and optional Data Space MCP server.
helm_values:
domain:
  host: librechat.{tenant_host}
  url: https://librechat.{tenant_host}
oidc:
  enabled: true
  issuer: https://dil.collab-cloud.eu/auth/realms/{tenant}
  clientId: librechat
vllm:
  baseUrl: http://vllm.default.svc.cluster.local:8000/v1
mcp:
  enabled: false
